purpose: Tighten the NRG4YOU Argenta station/program crosswalk using current public-authority evidence and independent operator/location corroboration without assigning unproven EVSE IDs.

investigated.program: Comune di Argenta / Comunita Solare municipal charging program

sites: Santa Maria Codifiume - Via Leopardi (fronte scuole)
authoritativeProgramEvidence.hardware: 4 municipal stations; each station 22 kW total with two 11 kW connections

secondaryAuthorityEvidence.finding: Confirms four slow municipal chargers installed in 2020, managed through an agreement with Comunita Solare, with subsidized 0.25 EUR/kWh pricing; enumerates Argenta Piazza Giovanni XXIII, Consandolo Viale Rimembranze, Anita Piazza del Popolo, Santa Maria Codifiume Via Leopardi.
secondaryAuthorityEvidence.note: The current service page says Anita Piazza Liberazione while the social report says Piazza del Popolo; treat this as a location-name/address discrepancy requiring identity resolution, not as two chargers.

operatorCorroboration.finding: Current third-party/OpenChargeMap-derived pages identify NRG4YOU at Consandolo Viale Rimembranze with two Type 2 22 kW sockets and at least one Argenta NRG4YOU site, supporting the NRG operator attribution but not providing canonical PUN EVSE IDs.

vietriControl.finding: Vietri tourism/public material explicitly labels NRG4YOU Corso Umberto I and links the same customer.restation.eu/stations surface; screenshot describes two paid Type 2 22 kW sockets.
vietriControl.use: confirms Restation is reused by NRG4YOU across distinct local programs; therefore Argenta tariff must remain program-scoped.

crosswalkProgress.nrgOperatorAttribution: corroborated but not sufficient for EVSE mutation

negativePaths: No public search result exposes IT*NRG* EVSE IDs for the four municipal sites.
Do not substitute OpenChargeMap/Chast connector counts or generic roaming prices for canonical PUN identity.
Do not infer that every NRG4YOU Restation station has the Argenta 0.25 EUR/kWh tariff.
Do not split Anita Piazza Liberazione/Piazza del Popolo into two sites until exact identity is established.
investigated.blocker: Need exact canonical PUN/OCPI EVSE identities for the four Argenta-program sites, or a Restation station/API payload carrying an identifier that can be joined deterministically to PUN.
investigated.resumeCondition: Query/inspect public or guest Restation station payloads for Argenta, Consandolo, Anita and Santa Maria Codifiume; recover station IDs and EVSE/external IDs, then join to canonical NRG inventory by exact ID or sufficiently unique first-party address+connector identity with collision audit.
investigated.confidence: high on program/site tariff scope; high on Restation surface; fail-closed on PUN EVSE mapping

next: Restation public/guest payload discovery for the four Argenta-program sites
Exact PUN NRG EVSE identity join and collision audit
If deterministic matches are obtained, promote only matched NRG subpopulation active->partial
